purpose: Locked S5 measurement for beat-matched parallel rendering. Accepts normalized, hash-bound feature entries and reports exactly six Burrows-Delta values (character 3/4/5-grams, POS trigrams, dependency n-grams, punctuation) plus their unweighted mean. Reuses the established family_distance primitive and frozen 200/200/200/300/300/all feature caps. No threshold, verdict, or selection key; no text, corpus, parser/model, or network path.
use_when: A consumer already has normalized six-family target and baseline feature entries
You need the frozen S5 measurement and binding hashes for a beat-matched render experiment
do_not_use_when: You need feature extraction from raw text (this surface accepts normalized entries only)
You need an authorship, AI/human, quality, ranking, or selection judgment

compute.cost_note: stdlib-only arithmetic over caller-supplied normalized feature maps; no text, corpus, model, or network access

examples.description: Compute the locked six-family S5 measurement
